text:
Carla: Heads-up: FinLedger via support ticket #7892 reporting intermittent 502/504 and slow timeouts since ~01:12 UTC in hosted prod-eu. Multiple customers affected. Logs show auth proxy 401 spikes then gateway 504s. Paging ops.
incidents-bot: Incident created INC-2026-345 by Carla. War-room channel #incidents created. :rotating_light:
Samir: I'm on it. Looking at auth-proxy and billing auth calls. Adding traces.
Jenni: I see elevated KMS error rates around 01:10-01:16. KMS throttling could cause token refresh failures -> 401 cascades.
Mike: Can someone grab a sample cURL from support ticket? Want to reproduce.
Carla: Support provided sample req/resp. Pasting headers (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
x-api-key: <redacted>
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```
Response: 401 then after retries 504
Samir: Running replay now against eu-hosted gateway with same key (safelab). If I can reproduce I'll attach trace id.
Ophelia: FYI rate limits show small spike from FinLedger but not enough to explain total 5xx.
Samir: Repro successful locally: sequence of 401 from auth-service (token refresh fails due to KMS 429), gateway retry leads to 504 queue timeout. Trace id: trc_0a1b2c3
Jenni: Confirmed KMS quota breach around 01:10 UTC for eu-west keys. Looks like background key rotation + traffic spike. KMS returned 429/503 intermittently.
Mike: Mitigation idea: temporarily relax token refresh to reuse existing tokens for 5m, and enable fallback auth cache. Can we toggle?
Carla: Ops: can we run a hotfix to bypass rotation and bump auth cache TTL? Who's owner?
Ophelia: I can patch auth-proxy config to extend cache TTL from 60s -> 300s and reduce rotation frequency. Rolling change requires deploy button.
incidents-bot: Change request tracked: CHG-844. Approving emergency config change.
Samir: Applying config to canary nodes now (eu-hosted-auth-proxy-01).
Samir: Canary looks good. 502/504 counts dropped in metrics. Applying to remainder.
Jenni: KMS quota request underway with provider. We're also throttling background rotation jobs.
Carla: Support notified FinLedger with interim mitigation and ETA for full fix. Asked them to confirm if errors stop.
FinLedger-Support: Confirming errors dropped after ~10min. Still seeing occasional late 504s but much improved. Thanks.
Mike: Action items: 1) Request permanent KMS quota increase (owner Jenni) 2) Add preflight KMS health check + circuit-breaker (owner Samir) 3) Improve auth cache fallback w/ canary and feature flag (owner Ophelia) 4) Customer comms debrief (owner Carla).
Jenni: I'll open the quota ticket with cloud provider this morning and add documentation for emergency rotation disable steps.
Samir: I'll write a small runbook to replay support sample and check trace ids, include playbook steps to toggle cache TTL.
Ophelia: I'll follow up with a postmortem draft and include dashboard panels for KMS 429/503 and auth-proxy retry queue length.
incidents-bot: INC-2026-345 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: Ophelia. Target PMR in 72h.
Carla: Thanks all. Closing war-room for now. Please update the incident tracker with timelines and attach logs. :thumbsup:
